item.title: Keystone Realtors to launch ₹5K cr worth housing properties in MMR by March
item.description: Realty firm Keystone Realtors Ltd will launch housing properties worth Rs 5,000 crore for sale by March next year in the Mumbai Metropolitan Region (MMR) as it remains bullish on consumer demand, a top company official said. Mumbai-based Keystone Realtors, which is one of the leading real estate developers in the country, sells properties under the 'Rustomjee' brand. In an interview with PTI, the company's Chairman and Managing Director Boman Irani exuded confidence that it would easily achieve the sales bookings or pre-sales target of Rs 5,000 crore for the 2026-17 fiscal. "In the first half of this fiscal, our sales bookings stood at around Rs 2,000 crore, which is 40 per cent of our total guidance for the entire 2026-27. In the real estate sector, sales are generally higher in the second half because of festive demand. So, we are on track to meet the target," he said. item.title: Sebi approves transfer of ICICI Securities' PMS biz to ICICI Prudential AMC
item.description: Market regulator Sebi has approved the proposed transfer of portfolio management services (PMS) business of ICICI Securities to ICICI Prudential Asset Management Company. The proposed acquisition will be carried out through a slump sale on a going-concern basis. "We hereby inform you that the company is in receipt of an email today... from ICICI Securities intimating receipt of a letter dated November 19, 2026, from Securities and Exchange Board of India (Sebi) approving transfer of PMS business from ICICI Securities to the company," ICICI Prudential AMC said in a stock exchange filing on Thursday. The company's board of directors approved the acquisition of the PMS business from ICICI Securities on August 10. Subsequently, both companies entered into a business transfer agreement for the transaction. The closing of the transaction was subject to receipt of requisite regulatory approvals. item.title: Tata Technologies aims to double its revenue by $1.3 billion by 2030
item.description: Tata Technologies Ltd, which provides product engineering and digital services to manufacturers, aims to double its revenue to USD 1.1-1.3 billion while expanding operating profit margin to more than 20 per cent by 2030. The company is betting on multiple large full-vehicle projects, software services and the aerospace and industrial heavy machinery segment. item.title: Blackstone stake buy to boost IIFL Finance's capital needs: Fitch Ratings
item.description: Blackstone's plan to acquire a 16 per cent stake in IIFL Finance will support the Indian firm's growth capital with an unlikely shift in IIFL's business model, which focuses on secured loans, Fitch Ratings said on Thursday. Fitch said with the investment, Blackstone would effectively become IIFL Finance's main private-equity shareholder. Fitch believes that the refreshed shareholder and board composition could alter IIFL's business strategy, risk appetite and growth trajectory. However, the significant injection of capital and foreign investment supports Indian financial institutions' capital and funding flexibility. Earlier this month, the board of IIFL Finance approved a plan to raise Rs 6,414 crore through a preferential issue. This included Rs 5,000 crore investment from Blackstone and Rs 1,264 crore by the company's promoters Nirmal Jain and R Venkataraman, besides Rs 150 crore from Anchorage Capital. item.title: TCI Express to invest ₹500 crore in 5 years to expand logistics infra
item.description: Logistics solutions company TCI Express Ltd on Thursday announced a Rs 500-crore infrastructure expansion plan for the next five years and the opening of three sorting centres in Ahmedabad, Lucknow and Kolkata, strengthening its nationwide express delivery network. Through these strategic investments, the company said it aims to build a future-ready logistics ecosystem, enhance service capabilities and reinforce its position as one of India's leading players in the sector. The company said it has already invested Rs 500 crore in the last seven years, and now intends to direct the new investment to high-performing verticals. "We are witnessing strong growth momentum across our business verticals, particularly domestic air express and e-commerce express, which have emerged as key growth drivers in FY2027. Our next phase of expansion will focus on strengthening the capabilities of individual verticals, enhancing operational efficiencies and building a more agile and scalable network,"

The airline's MD and CEO Tewolde Gebremariam will be making a presentation to the members, they added. It could not be immediately ascertained whether all the Tata Sons board members will be visiting the airline's headquarters. item.title: Tata Steel plans project to produce hydrogen using steel plant off-gases
item.description: Tata Steel, in partnership with Houston-based Utility Global, will undertake a project to produce hydrogen using steel plant off-gases at its Kalinganagar facility in Odisha, marking the first such initiative in the country, the company said on Wednesday. The two companies will undertake joint Front-End Engineering and Design (FEED) studies to support a Final Investment Decision (FID) by Tata Steel's board on the proposed project, it added. The proposed facility, based on Utility Global's H2Gen technology, will have a planned capacity of 10 tonnes per day (TPD) and use off-gases generated during the steelmaking process to produce high-purity hydrogen. "For any technology to make a meaningful contribution to steel decarbonisation, it needs to work at the scale and complexity of an operating steel plant.
